gen-gf-revalia-gf-pathway-extreme: A tall band of letters with short stalks gives Revalia its swagger, set against Pathway Extreme with its stubby ascenders and big x-height. Revalia grabs attention; Pathway Extreme holds it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-preahvihear: Revalia spaces its bold letters out in a relaxed stride. Preahvihear then drops in below with a lofty x-height and open mouths, so the heading's showiness gets a plainspoken partner.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-prompt: Expressive and widely spaced, Revalia fills the top with a g that leaves its lower curve open. And Prompt follows in a plain sans, its oversized small letters and open apertures making paragraphs go down easily.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption reads big-bodied and inviting, its bowls left unclosed, and that is what sits under Revalia's bold display lettering. The strongest quality here is how loud and how friendly each font is allowed to be.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-puritan: Revalia opens bold, with a relaxed stride across spaced-out letters. Puritan answers underneath in rounded sans forms with oversized e and a counters, so the showy heading gets a body that stays friendly and clear.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-questrial: That tall band of letters with short stalks makes Revalia instantly recognizable, and Questrial echoes it with a flat, stencil-cut line of single weight. And the strongest thing here is how one loud font and one measured font still share a skyline.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-radio-canada: Revalia's open-curved g and loosely spaced letters give the heading a relaxed, bold swagger. And Radio Canada brings the opposite habit, a constant line width with c, s and z standing full and tall.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big reads clean and plain sans, its monoline skeleton and big x-height filling the line. Revalia then takes the heading role, bold and widely spaced, while Radio Canada Big does the quiet work below.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-readex-pro: Revalia brings bold, expressive display letters with a relaxed stride and an open-bottomed g. And Readex Pro holds a steady, marker-like weight with broad terminal gaps, which is the strongest thing about this pair.
